data.one_liner: Detect root, jailbreak, emulators, and device security threats in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Security Plus is a Flutter plugin that provides device security checks such as root detection, emulator detection, development mode, mock location, and external storage detection.
use_when: You need to prevent your app from running on rooted Android devices or emulators.
You want to detect security risks like mock locations and development mode.
avoid_when: You require robust, guaranteed production-grade protection without reliance on client-side checks alone.
You only need standard device info without security checks.
strengths: Includes advanced root detection and Frida anti-tampering protection.
Provides multiple security check layers including emulator and mock location detection.
weaknesses: Client-side security checks can potentially be bypassed by advanced users.
iOS platform support is still marked as partial or under development in the platform table.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding location permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist for location-related security checks.
